001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamConverter.path.XPath;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.OutputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
010import java.io.Writer;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.logging.Logger;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
017import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
018import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
019import javax.xml.stream.XMLOutputFactory;
020import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
021import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
022
023/**
024 * XML Navigate Command Class
025 *
026 * <p>This class implements command for targeted XML transformation using XPath. It identifies
027 * specific elements using XPath expressions and applies IRule transformations to those elements
028 * while preserving the overall XML structure.
029 */
030public class XmlNavigateCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
031  private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(XmlNavigateCommand.class.getName());
032  private static final XMLEventFactory EVENT_FACTORY = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
033
034  private XPath xpath;
035  private IRule rule;
036
037  /**
038   * Constructor for XML navigation with typed XPath selector and transformation rule.
039   *
040   * @param xpath the typed XPath to select elements
041   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
042   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
043   */
044  public XmlNavigateCommand(XPath xpath, IRule rule) {
045    if (rule == null) {
046      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
047    }
048    this.xpath = xpath;
049    this.rule = rule;
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with typed XPath and rule.
054   *
055   * @param xpath the typed XPath to select elements
056   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
057   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that extracts the specified XPath with the given rule
058   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
059   */
060  public static XmlNavigateCommand create(XPath xpath, IRule rule) {
061    return new XmlNavigateCommand(xpath, rule);
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command that processes entire XML with explicit
066   * rule specification. This method makes the intention explicit: process all XML data with the
067   * given transformation rule.
068   *
069   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to entire XML
070   * @return an XmlNavigateCommand that processes entire XML with the given rule
071   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if rule is null
072   */
073  public static XmlNavigateCommand createForAll(IRule rule) {
074    return new XmlNavigateCommand((XPath) null, rule);
075  }
076
077  @Override
078  protected String getCommandDetails() {
079    if (xpath != null) {
080      return String.format("XmlNavigateCommand(xpath='%s')", xpath.getPath());
081    } else {
082      return "XmlNavigateCommand(entire XML)";
083    }
084  }
085
086  @Override
087  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
088      throws IOException {
089    try (Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
090      if (xpath == null) {
091        // Apply rule to entire XML content
092        applyRuleToEntireXml(inputStream, writer);
093      } else {
094        // Apply rule to specific XPath elements while preserving structure
095        applyRuleToXmlPath(inputStream, writer);
096      }
097    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
098      throw new IOException("XML processing error", e);
099    }
100  }
101
102  /** Apply transformation rule to entire XML content */
103  private void applyRuleToEntireXml(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
104      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
105    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
106    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
107
108    try {
109      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
110      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
111      processXmlEvents(eventReader, eventWriter, (event, data) -> rule.apply(data));
112    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
113      handleXmlException(e);
114    } finally {
115      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
116    }
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Apply transformation rule to specific XPath elements while preserving XML structure This is a
121   * simplified implementation - production version would need proper XPath library
122   */
123  private void applyRuleToXmlPath(InputStream inputStream, Writer writer)
124      throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
125    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
126    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
127
128    try {
129      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
130      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(writer);
131      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, xpath, rule);
132    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
133      handleXmlException(e);
134    } finally {
135      closeResources(eventReader, eventWriter);
136    }
137  }
138
139  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
140      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, XPath xpath, IRule rule)
141      throws XMLStreamException {
142    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
143    boolean inTargetElement = false;
144    int targetDepth = 0;
145
146    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
147      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
148
149      if (event.isStartElement()) {
150        String elementName = event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart();
151        currentPath.add(elementName);
152
153        if (xpath.matches(currentPath)) {
154          inTargetElement = true;
155          targetDepth = currentPath.size();
156          eventWriter.add(event);
157        } else if (inTargetElement) {
158          eventWriter.add(event);
159        }
160      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
161        if (inTargetElement) {
162          eventWriter.add(event);
163          if (currentPath.size() == targetDepth) {
164            inTargetElement = false;
165            // Add newline as simple characters
166            eventWriter.add(EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters("\n"));
167          }
168        }
169        currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
170      } else if (event.isCharacters() && inTargetElement) {
171        // Apply rule to character data in target elements
172        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
173        String transformedData = rule.apply(originalData);
174        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
175          // Create new character event with transformed data
176          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
177          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
178        } else {
179          eventWriter.add(event);
180        }
181      }
182    }
183  }
184
185  // Common factory methods and utilities
186  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
187    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
188    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
189    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
190      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
191    }
192    return reader;
193  }
194
195  private XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(Writer writer) throws XMLStreamException {
196    XMLOutputFactory outputFactory = XMLOutputFactory.newInstance();
197    return outputFactory.createXMLEventWriter(writer);
198  }
199
200  private void handleXmlException(XMLStreamException e) throws IOException {
201    String message = e.getMessage();
202    if (message != null && (message.contains("unclosed") || message.contains("end"))) {
203      throw new IOException("Invalid XML format - unclosed tags", e);
204    }
205    throw new IOException("Invalid XML format", e);
206  }
207
208  @FunctionalInterface
209  private interface CharacterDataProcessor {
210    String process(XMLEvent event, String data);
211  }
212
213  private void processXmlEvents(
214      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, CharacterDataProcessor processor)
215      throws XMLStreamException {
216    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
217      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
218
219      if (event.isCharacters()) {
220        String originalData = event.asCharacters().getData();
221        String transformedData = processor.process(event, originalData);
222
223        if (!originalData.equals(transformedData)) {
224          XMLEvent transformedEvent = EVENT_FACTORY.createCharacters(transformedData);
225          eventWriter.add(transformedEvent);
226        } else {
227          eventWriter.add(event);
228        }
229      } else {
230        eventWriter.add(event);
231      }
232    }
233    eventWriter.flush();
234  }
235
236  private void closeResources(XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter) {
237    if (eventReader != null) {
238      try {
239        eventReader.close();
240      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
241        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventReader: " + e.getMessage());
242      }
243    }
244    if (eventWriter != null) {
245      try {
246        eventWriter.close();
247      } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
248        LOGGER.warning("Failed to close XMLEventWriter: " + e.getMessage());
249      }
250    }
251  }
252}
